commentTextItems.html: Length outside off, taps it on its head to get it to deep third. Fifty up, thumbs up from Pant
Half-volley on leg, flicked to midwicket's right. Half-stopped. Concedes an extra
Pitched up on middle and leg, flicked to mid-on
Pitched up around off, defended to deep-backward point

commentPostTextItems.html: Adishwaran : "Tone down guys, they are not taking the new ball because of the over rate I suppose" But why not take it after bringing the pacer on?

commentPreTextItems.html: Five minutes to go. One, maybe two more overs to be bowled. Saleem has the ball. Around

commentTextItems.html: Fullish on off, defended to the bowler's right. 135ks
Pitched up on off, defended to the bowler

commentPostTextItems.html: Akhil: "Gill really is pulling a Kohli. Decent as a player, becomes unbelievably good as captain. Here's hoping he doesn't have a late slump" Late slumps are almost inevitable. The peak is to watch out for

commentPostTextItems.html: NJ: "I thought as Saleem comes, they took the new ball, what kind of strategy is this, are they expecting reverse swing???"

commentTextItems.html: Paddles it fine. Shortish ball spins a bit in, takes it down leg. Pant goes back and square-on in the crease, gets low and cradles the bat to middle it
Full on leg, 85ks, beats the flick and hits the chest. Extra bounce
Wide on a length, cut to deep-backward point
Length down leg, looks to help it fine with a flick. Misses

commentPostTextItems.html: abhishek: "Why is Afghanistan playing with only two specialist spinners, and why has one not bowled? Is he injured? Part-timeers has bowled 23 overs" Sharafuddin is an allrounder, not sure why he's bowled. Kharote's the only specialist, Shahidi's more of a batter isn't he

commentTextItems.html: One more dot. Length on leg, flicked to square leg. He's standing halfway back but went straight to him. Gill not risking a run

dismissalText.commentary: Yashasvi Jaiswal c †Afsar Zazai b Mohammad Saleem 24 (32b 5x4 0x6) SR: 75

dismissalComment.html: And this time Jaiswal's been given, on the field. A strangle down the leg side, what a way to get out! Back of a length and just rears up. Jaiswal should not have gone for another half-hearted flick, but he does right off his hips. Ball angles away and to the keeper

dismissalText.commentary: KL Rahul c Rahmanullah Gurbaz b Ziaur Rahman 100 (165b 11x4 0x6) SR: 60.6

dismissalComment.html: And now Rahul has bunted this straight to short extra cover... Who wouldathunk... Was full and there to be hit, right outside off. He goes for an expansive drive. But the ball flies off the bottom of his bat and flies right into the hands of Gurbaz. A breakthrough against the run of play

dismissalComment.html: Half-volley does the trick. 142ks on fifth stump. Sudharsan was going on one knee and played a flowing cover drive. Slightly late on it. Thickish deflection went to the keeper's left. Unlike a few overs earlier, it was in reach. Nice low catch Zazai

dismissalText.commentary: Yashasvi Jaiswal c †Afsar Zazai b Mohammad Saleem 24 (32b 5x4 0x6) SR: 75

dismissalComment.html: And this time Jaiswal's been given, on the field. A strangle down the leg side, what a way to get out! Back of a length and just rears up. Jaiswal should not have gone for another half-hearted flick, but he does right off his hips. Ball angles away and to the keeper

dismissalText.commentary: Sai Sudharsan c †Afsar Zazai b Mohammad Saleem 81 (104b 13x4 0x6) SR: 77.88

dismissalComment.html: Half-volley does the trick. 142ks on fifth stump. Sudharsan was going on one knee and played a flowing cover drive. Slightly late on it. Thickish deflection went to the keeper's left. Unlike a few overs earlier, it was in reach. Nice low catch Zazai

dismissalText.long: c Rahmanullah Gurbaz b Ziaur Rahman
dismissalText.commentary: KL Rahul c Rahmanullah Gurbaz b Ziaur Rahman 100 (165b 11x4 0x6) SR: 60.6

dismissalComment.html: And now Rahul has bunted this straight to short extra cover... Who wouldathunk... Was full and there to be hit, right outside off. He goes for an expansive drive. But the ball flies off the bottom of his bat and flies right into the hands of Gurbaz. A breakthrough against the run of play
